caveats: Groups are keyword proxies inferred from clause text (slices.py), not metadata, not certified personal attributes; a clause can be mis-assigned.
Groups with n < 100 have wide intervals; no conclusion on fairness or discrimination can be drawn from them.
The mix-adjusted gap compares a group with the accuracy its clause-type mix would predict; it is descriptive, not causal.
Counterfactual edits test stability of the clause TYPE; jurisdiction and currency edits change the legal content, so a stable type does not imply an equivalent clause.
